enchantments.tooltip: Quality Intelligence +3: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Combat Mastery +6: +6 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Deception +3: +3 Quality bonus to hit and +5 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Insightful Spell Focus Mastery +4: +4 Insight bonus to the DC of all spells.
